item.description: What starts as a simple rental deal is turning into a nightmare for Guwahati car owners as vehicles mysteriously disappear across state borders A worrying trend of vehicle fraud has been emerging in Guwahati, where unsuspecting car owners are being lured into renting out their four-wheelers for self-drive services or monthly contractual arrangements, only to discover later that their vehicles have been sold off in neighbouring states without their knowledge. item.title: Ganeshguri Sees Rising Concern Over Late-Night Crowds and Weak Monitoring
item.description: The recent late-night scuffle at Ganeshguri, barely a few metres away from Dispur Police Station, has once again brought into focus a growing concern in Guwahati; the unchecked expansion of late-night commercial activity and its increasing link to public disorder. What began as an isolated incident involving an allegedly inebriated individual soon turned into a wider discussion on enforcement gaps, civic responsibility and the evolving nature of the city’s nightlife. item.description: GUWAHATI: A previously unknown species of blind fish has been discovered in a village in Assam’s Goalpara district, marking the first groundwater-dwelling fish ever recorded in Northeast India and the wider Eastern Himalayan region, researchers said.
